scene: You skate up into the lighthouse lantern room beside an enormous spinning prism.
picture: Flat side-view inside the circular lantern room. On the left stands a brass telescope aimed at a window. You stand in your red bomber jacket and white roller skates beside the glowing glass prism spinning in the centre. On the far right is a steep iron ladder leading to a shut roof hatch.
shown: a mounted brass telescope on a sturdy tripod sitting on the left
a massive glowing glass prism slowly turning on its pedestal in the centre
a small metal roof hatch with an iron latch on the far right
